t: How to create blog post outline with Content AI?
html:

How to Enable Content AI?


Content AI access and billing are managed differently for agency users and sub-account users.


Agency-Level Management

  1. Switch to Agency View.

  2. Go to AI Suite > Plans & Limits.

  3. Locate the sub-account you want to manage.

  4. Click the three-dot menu next to the sub-account and select Configure Rebilling.

  5. Review the available AI products, including Content AI.

  6. Enable rebilling if you want to charge the client for supported Content AI usage, configure the available billing options, and save your changes.


Agency admins and agency users can access Content AI at no additional cost, subject to fair-use limits.


Sub-Account Access


Sub-account users can access Content AI through pay-per-use billing or an eligible AI Employee subscription.

  • Pay-Per-Use: Content AI usage is billed based on consumption.

  • AI Employee Subscription: Content AI usage is included in eligible Starter, Growth, and Unlimited subscriptions, subject to fair-use limits.


Agencies can manage billing configurations and AI usage limits for their sub-accounts. Available controls within a sub-account depend on its plan and agency settings.

For additional information, see AI Employee: Access, Rebilling and Reselling.



Pricing


Content AI pricing depends on the user's access type and the sub-account's AI Employee plan.

  • Agency admins and users: Content AI is included at no additional cost, subject to fair-use limits.

  • Sub-account users: Content AI is available through pay-per-use billing or an eligible AI Employee subscription.


For the latest rates, included usage, and plan limitations, see AI Product Pricing.


Please Note:

The first 500 words are FREE for each sub-account.

How many tones can I generate for the Content?

Content AI provides funny, casual, excited, professional, witty, sarcastic, feminine, masculine, bold, dramatic, grumpy, secretive, respectful, and persuasive.


I want to check the old generated Content; where can I prevent it?

To check the generated Content via Content AI, go to Automation> Content AI to learn more details and see the Content you have already generated—more details information in this article.
